title: Long customer and term names wrap in the Move window
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} has a 31-character name and is held by customer {Customer-A}, whose name is more than 60 characters long. Its other own term {Term-B} also has a 31-character name.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-21 Long Name TrmA, {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-21 Long Name TrmB and {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-21 A Very Long Customer Name For Wrapping Checks Ltd.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose {Term-B} in "Move To".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens. The title shows the whole of {Term-A} and the row shows the whole of {Customer-A}, wrapping onto more lines; nothing is cut off or ends in "...".
  • Step 3: the whole of {Term-B} shows in the dropdown, wrapping if needed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R23: “Customer names and term names are never cut off in the window title, the list or "Move To"; long names wrap.”
